name: Enforce Branch Permissions

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  permission-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check permissions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo " Checking branch permissions..."
          echo "Branch: $GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          echo "User who triggered the push: $GITHUB_ACTOR"

          # Restrict src branch
          if [[ "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" == "src" && "$GITHUB_ACTOR" != "YohanBandara" ]]; then
            echo "ERROR: Only UserA is allowed to push or open PRs to the 'src' branch."
            exit 1
          fi

          # Restrict debugging branch
          if [[ "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" == "debugging" && "$GITHUB_ACTOR" != "LGsekara1" ]]; then
            echo "ERROR: Only UserB is allowed to push or open PRs to the 'debugging' branch."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Permission check passed for this branch."
